dropped.item: Acknowledgment that this is not the experience the company wants the customer to have
Closing thanks for the customer's patience and repeated apology for the inconvenience
Assurance that the team will be glad to help with questions

changed.item: 'I apologize for the wait in getting back to you' became 'sorry it took us so long to get back to you', which more strongly concedes the delay was long
'we will send you a replacement battery' became 'we're sending you a replacement battery', which implies the shipment is already underway rather than a future commitment
'If you have any questions in the meantime' became 'If you have questions before then', which narrows the invitation to the period before shipping or tracking rather than open-ended
